definitions.explanation: The act of staying in a place when others have left, or continuing to remain in a position or organization.
Substances or effects that remain after a process, especially chemicals or contaminants that persist in food, soil, or the body.

notes:
{残留|ざんりゅう} combines {残|ざん} (remain) and {留|りゅう} (stay), emphasizing staying in place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残留|ざんりゅう}⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧ — residual pesticides
- {残留|ざんりゅう}⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧ — residual substance
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{残留|ざんりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to stay on a team
- {残留|ざんりゅう}{邦人|ほうじん} — Japanese nationals remaining abroad

In sports news, {残留|ざんりゅう} is commonly used when discussing whether a player will stay with their current team or transfer (⟦{移籍|いせき}→移籍：13780_iseki⟧). In science and food safety, it refers to chemical residues.
